snippet.title: Delta Squared - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A Retro GBC-inspired Arcade-like SHMUP for PC! It's now available on Itchio (link below)!! It will cost just 1$ and it's my first commercial game that I've worked on as a solo indie developer! 

Get the game here: https://thiago-avidos.itch.io/delta-squared

Here follows the game's description:

Change the destiny of Delta Town!

Square Queen Shiberia has invaded the city with the Square army! They want to transform all citizens into squares, and only you can save them!

It'll first be available at Itch.io for Windows.
I'll expand to Gamejolt, Steam and possibly Linux as soon as possible!

More details will be available at my Itch.io page, Twitter and Instagram!
